#### The Long, Hard End of the Chilean Nitrates Industry

- When German farmers resisted synthetic fertilizers despite their availability, only 16% of soil nitrogen came from artificial sources in 1913, delaying adoption.

- When John Thomas North bought Peruvian nitrate certificates for 50% of face value before Chile's announcement, he gained 71% industry control through legal loopholes.
- When Guggenheim Brothers used centrifuges to cut extraction costs by 40%, they secured a 95% monopoly through government debt and market control.

#### The Chinese Hamster Revolutionized Medicine
